observations.topic: Independent topology and complete source inventory
observations.observation: All eight source wire segments, two filled junctions, upper R and lower circular V are preserved. The lower branch is a real conductive branch, not a voltage-scope annotation. Its left pin joins the left resistor node and its right pin returns to the right resistor node. There is no third branch or unintended short. The independent visual trace agrees with the saved two-net parallel assertion for both components.

observations.topic: Return wire and component boundary continuity
observations.observation: In all three actual previews the wire exiting V turns upward into the filled right node without a gap or ambiguous crossing. The left descent similarly meets the filled left node. Wires stop at the circle and resistor boundaries; empty symbol interiors are not crossed by bypass strokes. Both branch endpoints therefore remain the same two electrical nodes.
